title: レース場グルメの誘惑

text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen and I have come to watch a race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Soba, udon, steak, soft serve ice cream, carrot donuts—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No. Earlier in class, we were discussing racecourse food.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This scent of excessively seasoned junk food… I'd never noticed it before, but now…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Its inescapable allure is drawing me in!
choice_data_list: Do you want to take a look?
Do you want to take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …Yes. I cannot deny the curiosity born from everyone's discussion of these flavors.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That's why there is something for which I must request your cooperation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would disgrace the Mejiro family name if I am left completely ignorant of the foods being offered here. So, would you come have a taste with me?
An interesting proposition, but everything on offer sounds rather unhealthy.
choice_data_list: You know what, let's eat until we're stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's! Now, I will take half—no! Just a bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The strong flavor comes as a surprise initially, but… Yes, I can see why this is a popular topic of conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I seldom get to experience this sort of flavor at home or at the academy, but just one bite is enough to tell me it lacks nutritional balance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's delicious, but… you could call it a natural enemy to those on a diet. Yes, a taboo flavor! I must be careful not to overindulge.
Mejiro McQueen shivers as we depart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-yes… I can see why this food is such a popular topic of conversation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I've eaten more than I anticipated, which has resulted in quite a painful situation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I-it's not my fault! I was entranced by the delicious aroma of junk food!
Mejiro McQueen ate so much that she can't seem to focus on watching the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk… I understand. If those are your directions, then I will abide by them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: E-even so, I would like to have the opportunity someday! After all, it is a Mejiro's duty to expand her horizons!
Mejiro McQueen seems to have overcome this temptation.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! Why would you suggest such a thing?! You are… aware of my constitution, aren't you?
choice_data_list: A half-hearted attitude doesn't befit a Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh… I-I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It's true. There is some logic to what you say. Even so, engorging myself willy-nilly would be…

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh? It's you two. Did you also come to watch the race?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Ikuno!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To tell you the truth, uh… y-yes, that's right! Would you care to join us?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We were just thinking of taking a break to sample some of the racecourse food. …Isn't that right, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's nice. I'm in need of a break myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Y-yes! With someone as knowledgeable about nutrition as Ikuno at my side, I'll have no problem exercising restraint.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, shall we go take a look at the food? I-I was thinking I might try something on the lighter side.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Something light? That's surprising. There are a lot of desserts. I thought for sure you'd be drawn to those.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urk… Uh, um…
choice_data_list: You're curious about them now, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: …I have my eye on the low-sugar crepes. They're gluten free and rich in protein. They also have a reputation for being sweet despite the low calorie count.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Such a wonderful thing exists?! I would love to try it!
Mejiro McQueen enjoys some racecourse food along with Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I had not considered that! Yes, it's just as you say. It would be a discredit to the Mejiro name to claim full understanding from just one measly bite.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Very well! This is for future reference. I shall partake to my heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Nom nom… They used quality sweet red beans. The slight saltiness enhances the sweetness, and the dough is delicate and flaky!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Next, I shall try the cream taiyaki! The chocolate ones look delicious as well. Perhaps I should have both!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, these churros seem to be freshly made! Such a wonderful smell… I'd better line up right now!
Mejiro McQueen thoroughly enjoys her sweets. However, the calories pile on.
